rebar-debug Phase 1 exit (2026-07-27):

Blind-investigator fishbone:
- Code logic: `push_tickets_branch` always returns None and swallows publication failures (`src/rebar/_store/push.py:108-174`); `emit_code_review_artifact` therefore returns a local artifact id as apparent success (`src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py:260-367`). After the external vote, the voter records dedup before artifact emission (`voter.py:703-737`); both the local-dedup and Gerrit-existing-vote guards return before any artifact work (`voter.py:513-543`).
- State/config/environment candidates (invalid PAT, write-dead clone, ownership, recovery state, ambient-store misrouting) can initiate the persistence failure, but all funnel into the same non-recoverable state-machine defect. Sidecar-only failure would leave a visible CREATE and is not needed to explain total absence.

Discriminating runtime proof:
1. An initialized ephemeral tracker was wired to a rejecting remote and driven through the real emitter. The emitter returned a code_review id; the local artifact, REVIEW_RESULT commits, and relates_to link existed; the remote contained zero revision commits; no ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR marker was emitted. This confirms silent local-only success and rules out verdict/trailer/bootstrap failure for that mechanism.
2. The real review entry point was instrumented on retry. With either a recorded dedup row or an existing Gerrit vote, it returned `dedup` / `already_voted_gerrit` and invoked the artifact emitter zero times. This confirms the failed artifact cannot self-heal on ordinary webhook/reconciler delivery.
3. The write-dead-store regression produced None plus ARTIFACT_EMIT_ERROR, distinguishing bootstrap/write failure. Forcing sidecar.emit=False produced a CREATE-only artifact and no outer marker, distinguishing the inner-swallow alternative. Focused artifact coverage remained green (21 tests; the code-trace investigator independently ran 25 focused tests).

Proven root cause: the review-bot ledger models only “vote completed,” not “artifact durably persisted.” Artifact work occurs after that irreversible state, the publish API cannot report durability failure, and both normal retry guards suppress recovery. Consequently any post-vote store/publish fault can leave a healthy +1 vote with no shared artifact forever. This one mechanism explains the live vote, missing shared ticket/link/payload, healthy process, absent publish-specific marker, and persistence across retries.

Legitimacy: DEFECT. Story ef70-e108-e6d4-4d7c and `voter.py:269-274` require one durable revision-scoped artifact per completed review; dogfood story 9447-b31c-e0b7-446d authoritatively requires its ambient-store v2 trace.

Caller-dependency gate: expected post-fix behavior is that votes remain non-blocking while artifact durability is explicitly observable and incomplete artifacts remain recoverable. The emitter has one production caller. Generic push callers rely on best-effort/no-raise, so that existing API must remain unchanged; artifact-specific reporting/recovery can be added without a behavioral dependency conflict. Dedup/reconciler callers rely only on preventing duplicate votes, not on suppressing missing-artifact repair. Phase 2 is unlocked.
